name: soft_bool_inherit1.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (d Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SoftBoolBase (mk-SoftBoolBase (p Bool)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SoftBoolDerived (mk-SoftBoolDerived (p Bool)(q Bool)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-SoftBoolBase (sel-SoftBoolBase SoftBoolBase))
  (lift-SoftBoolDerived (sel-SoftBoolDerived SoftBoolDerived))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SoftBoolBase ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SoftBoolBase (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SoftBoolBase ((this Ref)) SoftBoolBase
  (sel-SoftBoolBase (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SoftBoolDerived ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SoftBoolDerived (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SoftBoolDerived ((this Ref)) SoftBoolDerived
  (sel-SoftBoolDerived (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SoftBoolBase ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-SoftBoolBase this)
    (deref-is-SoftBoolDerived this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SoftBoolDerived ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SoftBoolDerived this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.d: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!d ((this Ref)) Ref
  (d (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -----------------------------------
;   Getters for class SoftBoolBase:
; -----------------------------------

; --- getters for SoftBoolBase.p: ---

(define-fun SoftBoolBase!p ((this Ref)) Bool
  (p (deref-SoftBoolBase this))
)

; --------------------------------------
;   Getters for class SoftBoolDerived:
; --------------------------------------

; --- getters for SoftBoolDerived.p: ---

(define-fun SoftBoolDerived!p ((this Ref)) Bool
  (p (deref-SoftBoolDerived this))
)

; --- getters for SoftBoolDerived.q: ---

(define-fun SoftBoolDerived!q ((this Ref)) Bool
  (q (deref-SoftBoolDerived this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SoftBoolDerived (TopLevelDeclarations!d this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SoftBoolBase:
; -------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-SoftBoolBase SoftBoolBase)

; --- Soft Constraint 1: ---

(define-fun SoftBoolBase.soft1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (SoftBoolBase!p this)
)

(assert-soft (SoftBoolBase.soft1 1) :weight 1 :id k_soft)



; ----------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SoftBoolDerived:
; ----------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-SoftBoolDerived SoftBoolDerived)

; --- Soft Constraint 1: ---

(define-fun SoftBoolDerived.soft1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (SoftBoolDerived!p this)
)

(assert-soft (SoftBoolDerived.soft1 2) :weight 1 :id k_soft)

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun SoftBoolDerived.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (and (SoftBoolDerived!p this) (SoftBoolDerived!q this)))
)

(assert (! (SoftBoolDerived.inv2 2) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Soft Constraint 3: ---

(define-fun SoftBoolDerived.soft3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (SoftBoolDerived!q this)
)

(assert-soft (SoftBoolDerived.soft3 2) :weight 2 :id k_soft)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-SoftBoolBase const-1-SoftBoolBase))
        2 (lift-SoftBoolDerived const-2-SoftBoolDerived))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-2-SoftBoolDerived () SoftBoolDerived
  (mk-SoftBoolDerived false true))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (and (p (sel-SoftBoolDerived (select heap 2)))
                (q (sel-SoftBoolDerived (select heap 2))))))
  (not a!1)))
(define-fun const-1-SoftBoolBase () SoftBoolBase
  (mk-SoftBoolBase true))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (d (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-SoftBoolDerived a!1)))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2)))
                  1
                  (lift-SoftBoolBase (mk-SoftBoolBase true)))))
  (store a!1 2 (lift-SoftBoolDerived (mk-SoftBoolDerived false true)))))
